question: G235: THE TYPE-III READING -- does the operator-algebra description (hy4 H057 V13: dark sector as a type III factor with no trace; V16: KMS condition for the phantom at T_b = 9.52 K) carry physical content, or is it decoration? Type-I vs type-III observable, the KMS/FDT check at the committed T_b, and the honest verdict.

sources.H057_V13: dark sector as a type III factor with no trace -> explains no-particle/no-free-streaming (H047) and no conventional thermodynamics
sources.H057_V16: the phantom as a KMS state at the equilibrium temperature sigma^2 = 0.5 sqrt(G M_b a_0)
sources.H047: the dust as a coherent Noether charge: lambda_fs = 0, R(k) = 1, sigma^2 = 0 (12/12 pass)
sources.G093: the free dust is a COLD species m >= 3.3-5.7 keV, lambda_fs 0.50-0.82 Mpc, 11 eV relic dead at 103-190 Mpc (2s/95CL)
sources.G115: the warm floor turns G079's closure gap into a prediction: damping cuts the halo function at M_hm ~ 5e5-5.8e6 Msun; the mixed/unequilibrated warm-relic reading is killed
sources.G116: one species, two phases; one mass window m in [3.3,100] keV; equilibrium TG floor m > 23.25 eV satisfied automatically
sources.G084: THE LAW: the phantom is the GLOBAL MAXIMUM of S = -int rho ln(rho sigma^3) dV in the fixed baryon well Phi = C ln r, at the virial rung 4 temperature sigma^2 = C/2 -> rho = A/r^2; the sector temperature is T = m_sec sigma^2/k_B; dS/dE = 1/sigma^2 (the equilibrium's own beta)
sources.G132: T_b = m sigma^2/k_B = 9.52 K (5 keV, G081 constants); the phantom->free-dust crossing is FIRST-ORDER (L finite, L/N = 8.86-19.47 meV/particle, L/(N k_B T_b) = 10.8-23.7); N_ph = M_b/m = 1.561983e73; S_ph = 22.8-23.8 k_B/particle

section1_typeIII_claim.claimed_correspondence: type III factor (no trace, no number operator, no density-matrix entropy) <-> no particle + no free-streaming (H047: lambda_fs = 0, R(k) = 1) + no conventional thermodynamics

what_would_differ_typeI_vs_typeIII.the_entropy_observable: type I: a finite, extensive von Neumann entropy S = -Tr(rho ln rho) with a countable packing of degrees of freedom (Sackur-Tetrode, per-particle entropy finite). type III: NO trace, so no finite per-degree-of-freedom entropy -- the local/algebra entropy is regulator-divergent (area/volume-law with a UV/IR divergence). THE DISCRIMINATOR.
what_would_differ_typeI_vs_typeIII.the_entanglement_observable: type III: infinite entanglement entropy between a region and its complement (QFT area-law divergence). type I: finite entanglement (bounded von Neumann entropy of the reduced state, ~ ln N). Not directly observable in this classical framework.
what_would_differ_typeI_vs_typeIII.the_coarse_graining_observable: type III: the equilibrium is a KMS state and the coarse-graining is set by modular flow (Tomita-Takesaki). This is the ONLY genuinely physical handle -- but it reduces to 'the sector is a thermal state at a definite temperature', which the framework already commits (G084).
what_would_differ_typeI_vs_typeIII.the_candidate_named: THE CANDIDATE OBSERVABLE: the FINITE MEAN ENTROPY PER DEGREE OF FREEDOM at fixed mass -- the phantom's S/N = 22.8-23.8 k_B per particle at m = 5 keV with N_ph = M_b/m = 1.56e73, computed via the Sackur-Tetrode-like law (D = 3 momentum space). A type-I sector has this finite and regulator-independent; a strict type-III sector would render it divergent.

the_key_insight.note: lambda_fs = 0 and R(k) = 1 (H047) do NOT discriminate type I vs type III -- a TYPE-I COHERENT CONDENSATE (a Bose condensate / N particles in one mode, zero velocity dispersion) has exactly the same signature: no free-streaming, R(k) = 1, no discrete propagating particles. So H047's no-particle/no-free-streaming is NOT evidence for type III; it is shared by a type-I coherent state. The free-streaming suppression that the WDM kill (G093/G115: 11 eV warm relic dead at 103-190 Mpc; warm floor damping cut at 5e5-5.8e6 Msun) requires is the fact that the sector has ONE thermal velocity ~ 0, which both type-I-coherent and type-III realize.
the_key_insight.measured: R_framework(100 h/Mpc) = 1.000000 (H047 N10); lambda_fs = 0 (H047 N2); R_WDM(3.5 keV, 100) = 2.90e-4

section2_KMS_FDT.the_KMS_content: For an observable algebra with time evolution alpha_t, a state omega is KMS at inverse temperature beta iff there is an analytic two-point function F_AB(z) on the strip 0 < Im z < beta with F_AB(t) = omega(A alpha_t(B)) and F_AB(t+i beta) = omega(alpha_t(B) A); in Fourier, tilde(G)_BA(-omega) = e^{-beta omega} tilde(G)_AB(omega). Physically: two-sided (positive/negative frequency) correlation functions are related by the Boltzmann factor at the equilibrium temperature -- this IS the content of thermal equilibrium and of the fluctuation-dissipation theorem.

beta_at_Tb.note: k_B T_b/m = 1.47473e10 m^2/s^2 equals the committed dispersion sigma^2 = 1.47470e10 m^2/s^2 to 2e-5 -> the phantom IS the Maxwellian thermal state at T_b by construction: <v^2>_3D = 3 k_B T_b/m = 3 sigma^2 = 4.424e10 m^2/s^2, v_rms = 210.3 km/s.

the_framework_own_beta_from_entropy_maxi.note: the equilibrium's own thermodynamic beta 1/(m sigma^2) (from dS/dE = 1/sigma^2 at the global entropy maximum, G084) equals the KMS beta 1/(k_B T_b) to 2e-5. G084's maximum-entropy construction IS the KMS/thermal (canonical) condition: the KMS condition was already derived, classically, by entropy maximization at the virial rung.

the_FDT_test_at_own_Tb.classical_FDT: S(omega) = 2 Re Z(omega) k_B T (force-noise spectrum vs real admittance), or Einstein relation D = mu k_B T_b. Since the NORMALIZATION k_B T_b/m = sigma^2 IS the definition of T_b, the isothermal equilibrium satisfies the Einstein/FDT relation IDENTICALLY for ANY drag or relaxation channel: D = sigma^2/tau_rel = (k_B T_b/m)/tau_rel = mu k_B T_b, zero free parameters. The FDT at the committed T_b is an identity, not a test.
the_FDT_test_at_own_Tb.the_gap: the framework has committed NO two-time correlation function and NO response/admittance chi(omega) or friction coefficient for the phantom sector (the only committed dynamics: the frozen-scalar fluid c_s^2 in [1/2, 1-] , H047 N6/N8 -- a FROZEN, non-propagating sector with no free degrees; and the free dust c_s = 0). Without a committed chi(omega) or noise spectrum S(omega), the nontrivial (frequency-dependent) FDT cannot be run: it is UNTESTED, not violated.
the_FDT_test_at_own_Tb.quantum_classical_ratio: hbar omega_orb / (k_B T_b) = 3.16e-28 at orbital frequency ~4e-16 s^-1 -> utterly classical; the quantum KMS crossing factor e^{-beta hbar omega} degenerates to unity, so KMS reduces to the classical Maxwellian = the committed equilibrium. No quantum two-sided structure is testable in this framework.

verdicts.V1_the_typeIII_translation: DECORATION with a real but already-committed core. The honest testable observable that differs between a type-I and a type-III dark sector is the FINITE MEAN ENTROPY PER DEGREE OF FREEDOM at fixed mass. The framework's own bookkeeping is TYPE-I-LIKE: S/N = 22.8-23.8 k_B/particle at fixed m = 5 keV (G084/G132), a finite, regulator-independent, extensive entropy over a countable packing N_ph = M_b/m = 1.56e73 particles via a D = 3 Sackur-Tetrode law. A strict type-III sector would render that entropy divergent, which the committed data do not and cannot contain. The claimed discriminator -- H047's no-particle / lambda_fs = 0 / R(k) = 1 -- does NOT separate type I from type III (a type-I coherent condensate shares it). So V13 adds no observable that is not already a thermal/coherent statement; its only physical residue is the honest 'no discrete propagating particle' reading, which a condensate realizes in type I too.
verdicts.V2_the_KMS_FDT_check: SATISFIED-AS-AN-IDENTITY, NOT MEASURED. The phantom is a KMS state at its own T_b = 9.52 K by construction: the equilibrium's thermodynamic beta 1/(m sigma^2) (G084 dS/dE = 1/sigma^2, 6.78e-11) equals the KMS beta 1/(k_B T_b) to 2e-5; k_B T_b/m = sigma^2 to 2e-5; <v^2>_3D = 3 sigma^2 = 4.424e10 m^2/s^2 -> v_rms = 210.3 km/s is exactly the Maxwellian at T_b. Therefore the isothermal sector satisfies the classical FDT/Einstein relation at T_b IDENTICALLY (D = (k_B T_b/m) mu = sigma^2 mu, zero free parameters) -- the fluctuation-dissipation balance is the definition of the temperature, not an independent test. The nontrivial FDT (a committed chi(omega) or noise spectrum) is UNTESTED: the repo has no two-time correlation or response function for the phantom sector (H047 N3, N7: c_s = 0 for the free dust, c_s^2 in [1/2,1-] for the frozen scalar -- no free propagating degrees). V16 is true-but-empty: true because every thermal state is KMS, empty because the framework's own max-entropy construction already derived that it is a thermal state at sigma^2 = C/2.
verdicts.V3_the_honest_statement: The operator-algebra reading of the committed equilibrium is DECORATION: the phantom was already characterized in G084/G132 as a finite-temperature, type-I-like MAXIMUM-ENTROPY thermal state (finite per-particle entropy 22.8 k_B over countable N = 1.56e73, self-consistent beta, first-order T_b = 9.52 K transition). The type III claim neither adds an observable nor explains anything H047's coherent-condensate picture does not already explain -- and it is in TENSION with the framework's own arithmetic (type III has no finite per-particle entropy; the framework computes one). The statement is maintained ONLY if 'type III' is redefined as the already-committed, trivial claim 'the number of distinguishable microstates is not a fundamental observable' (the coherent-charge reading of H047). THE TEST THAT TELLS DEEP STRUCTURE FROM DECORATION: (a) commit ONE two-time correlation function of the phantom sector (velocity autocorrelation or the scalar-mediated force-fluctuation spectrum, i.e. a real chi(omega) or S(omega)) and check the frequency-dependent FDT at T_b -- a genuine response spectrum would make the KMS reading physical; (b) the type-III discriminator: measure whether the phantom's local entropy stays FINITE per degree of freedom (type I, 22.8 k_B -- committed) or DIVERGES under coarse-graining (type III -- uncommitted, unfalsified because no entropy divergence scale was ever defined). On the committed record the answer is: type-I-like, decoration-only.
